name: Pet Shigan ~Chijoku ni Nureru Binkan Ane Mineko
original_name: ペット志願～恥辱に濡れる敏感姉　美音子
source:
Daiki spends his days in constant worry about the nightly sexual teasing by his older sister Mineko. One day, a classmate of his recommends he get a pet cat. Since Daiki is allergic, that seems unlikely... but then his sister offers to become that cat for him!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ060759.html]DLsite English[/url]]
